brief:
Settlers attacked the town of Beita south of Nablus, destroying a large number of equipment and facilities, according to Maan Wire. Video documentation showed extensive damage from fires set during the assault.

The incident occurred in the Palestinian town located in the southern region of Nablus governorate, an area that has witnessed repeated clashes between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers.
title: Settlers burn equipment, facilities in attack on Beita south of Nablus
